All admin pages use 'grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4' for stat cards - correct responsive pattern
Finance tabs use 'flex-wrap h-auto gap-1 p-1' for proper wrapping on mobile
Tables have 'overflow-x-auto' for horizontal scrolling on mobile
DashboardLayout.jsx: Mobile sidebar uses translate-x approach with z-50 for sidebar, z-40 for overlay

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 60 verified all mobile responsiveness fixes: 1) Stat cards display in 2-column grid on mobile across all admin pages (Dashboard, Finance, HR, Accounting, Monitoring, Lessons, Scheme of Work). 2) Tabs wrap properly in rows on mobile. 3) Tables have horizontal scroll (overflow-x-auto). 4) Hamburger menu opens sidebar as overlay with close button. 5) Topbar shows all elements compactly on mobile. The key fix was removing aggressive CSS !important overrides in App.css that were forcing all grids to single column.
